text:
Maya (Design): Quick check: should bulk-approve live as a header action or only per-row? Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/unique. Also thinking about how to show sample diffs in the confirm modal.
Lee (PM): Header action is fine but only when selected items share the same scorecard + tags. Otherwise per-row to avoid accidental wide changes.
Ibrahim (Frontend): If header CTA, show a small count badge and an explicit confirmation flow. Keyboard shortcut scoped to the list (e.g., Shift+A). Show the shortcut in the header text: 'Selected 2 • Shift+A'.
Nora (A11y): Accessibility constraints: the shortcut hint must not live only in a tooltip. Provide an sr-only string for screen readers and ensure the confirm modal traps focus and is announced via aria-live.
Vik (Backend): API proposal: POST /api/v1/evals/bulk_approve { ids[], comment, apply_to_all:false }. Return 207 with per-id status and reasons for failures. UI should render inline errors per id.
Priya (Research): Confirm modal should show 2-3 sample outputs (collapsible) and a link to the full regression diff. That helps reviewers spot-check quickly. Also log which sample ids were shown.
Maya (Design): Microcopy candidates: 'Approve selected' (preferred), 'Bulk approve', 'Approve all'. I prefer 'Approve selected' + confirmation header 'Approve 2 results?'. Body: 'This will mark the selected outputs as approved. Undo available from activity log for 10 minutes.' Thoughts?
Lee (PM): 'Approve selected' works. Be explicit about scope and undo window.
Ibrahim (Frontend): Undo toast: 'Approval applied. Undo?' with an inline link. While rollback runs show a subtle spinner. Toast should be polite aria-live. Esc closes modal.
Nora (A11y): When modal opens move focus to Confirm. After success move focus to toast action. Add aria-describedby on confirm pointing to the sample diffs. Test with NVDA and VoiceOver.
Vik (Backend): For partial failures (stale_version, perms), include retry token per id so front-end can retry safely. We'll also write the audit entry: user_id, eval_ids, action, timestamp, sample_ids.
Maya (Design): Visual note: for bulk action use outline button + badge to reduce perceived severity. Tooltip short: 'Approve selected (Shift+A)'. Header hint always visible on small screens.
Priya (Research): Add disclosure in modal: 'Also apply to all matching results in this run' (danger). Keep collapsed by default and require an extra confirm step if expanded.
Lee (PM): OK to ship as staged feature: header CTA behind a feature flag until accessibility checks done. Can we sync tomorrow 11am to sign off?
Maya (Design): Yes, I'll update the mock and post new frames here prior to the sync. Thanks everyone.
